name: Seventies Fun
description: A paint with an animated pattern that serves as an aesthetic coating for your tank. Its color scheme might potentially offer some camouflage benefits, but besides that, the paint does not offer any functional gameplay advantages.
interestingFacts: This paint was added to the game on November 2nd, 2019.
The paint could be received as a reward for reaching the paid Tier 21 of the November 2019 Challenge.
Seventies Fun was added to the possible rewards pool of containers with the release of the December 2019 Challenge.
